svg.title: Mind Map Studio: install it as an app, work offline, update when you choose
svg.desc: A looping animation in three scenes. 1: in Chrome or Edge the install icon at the right of the address bar installs Mind Map Studio, which then opens in its own window. 2: with the network off the app shows Offline (changes stay on this device); a node is added, the views switch between Mind Map, Outline and Brainstorm, and after a reload everything is still there, because the service worker caches every file of the app. 3: back online, a banner says A new version of Mind Map Studio is ready, with Reload and Later; Reload saves the open project first and then reloads.

g.text: Chrome or Edge: the install icon in the address bar. It opens in its own window.
Everything is still here after the reload
Its service worker caches every file of the app; projects live in the browser.
A new version of Mind Map Studio is ready.
A banner offers the new version; Reload saves your work, then reloads.
